notes.title: Steam Playtest available until Nov 10!
notes.content:
Hi! Worm Game has a Steam Playtest this weekend from 8-10 November. I'd love for you to try the game in its current state, and please join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/EN7DBbqaQw]discord[/url] and let me know what you think! It has some hitches and bumps and lacking some content and polish, so know that the full release will have more stuff!

- Rune (developer)
